policy.role_addition_model: rooted sequence; a stage owner may be an earlier role
policy.row_identity: grain primary key remains unchanged at every stage
policy.inheritance_scope: all currently exposed physical boundaries required by any later declared stage are copied
policy.terminal_boundary_mode: property-fd skips the final cut; complete preserves it
policy.legacy_final_layer_unfolding_boundary_po: if the legacy helper is invoked separately, prefix-owned copies remain on the prefix; final-role-owned copies move to the deduplicated factor and return on refold
policy.next_stage_source: preceding MV inherited relationship; source schema adjacency fallback is forbidden
policy.repeated_physical_labels_supported: explicit N1/N2 and R1/R2 aliases only

normalization.scope: optional legacy helper peels only the final fold layer

execution.source_policy: the original graph is read-only; all recursive nodes and inherited edge copies are run-scoped and removed
execution.continuation_policy: stage 1 reads the source join; every later stage must consume the preceding MV's actual inherited boundary

configuration.stage_validation_policy: source shape and per-stage cardinality are checked; the final folded stage uses a full value fingerprint

final_fd_redundancy_payload.metric: UTF-8 bytes for strings and UTF-8 bytes of str(value) for other types; this is a value-payload proxy, not Neo4j store bytes

fold_replacement_footprint.note: counterfactual replacement comparison; the experiment keeps the physical source graph unchanged

source.identity_policy: all declared TPC-H physical source labels and relationship identities are counted once; experiment artifacts are excluded

property_cells.definition: logical TPC-H node-property cells including declared primary and foreign-key columns; relationship properties and experiment bookkeeping properties are excluded

source.identity_policy: physical source labels and relationship identities are counted once across logical N1/N2 and R1/R2 aliases

property_cells.definition: logical TPC-H node-property cells including declared primary and foreign-key columns; relationship properties and experiment bookkeeping properties are excluded
logical TPC-H business-property cells; declared source primary/foreign keys are included and experiment bookkeeping properties are excluded

fold_replacement_footprint.shared_dimension_note: P is a property occurrence count, not a Neo4j node count; NATION/REGION configuration metrics are reported separately from the graph-object replacement totals
fold_replacement_footprint.relationship_to_update_layout: legacy complete-topology counterfactual may omit unmatched selected-table residual rows; the authoritative node/property footprint for update timing is full_8table_replacement_update.actual_lossless_graph_layout_footprint

redundancy.value_payload_metric: UTF-8 bytes for strings; UTF-8 bytes of str(value) for other non-NULL values; this is not Neo4j on-disk storage

configuration_redundancy.identity_policy: logical N1/N2 and R1/R2 roles are reconciled by physical source label plus primary key
configuration_redundancy.timing_scope: supplemental read-only metric; paired full-layout update timing is reported separately under full_8table_replacement_update
configuration_redundancy.configuration_update_amplification: not measured by this NATION/REGION subreport; see the complete physical target manifest in full_8table_replacement_update

full_8table_replacement_update.research_question: steady-state scalar-update cost of a complete normalized eight-table graph layout versus a lossless fold-replacement graph layout, plus one full destructive replacement-to-normalized conversion time

workload.role_identity_policy: N1/N2 and R1/R2 are physical occurrences of NATION/REGION, not additional logical facts
workload.property_scope: one non-key, non-FK scalar property on every row

layout_semantics.normalized: one run-scoped property clone per source row in each of the eight physical TPC-H relations
layout_semantics.replacement: final folded primary plus unaffected-table clones, unmatched selected-table residuals, and required shared Nation/Region companions
layout_semantics.topology_scope_note: the complete starting topology is materialized and held constant; PK/FK changes and rewiring remain a separate topology-update workload

replacement_to_normalized_conversion.conversion: full lossless replacement to full normalized layout
replacement_to_normalized_conversion.cache_policy: warm cache; server page/query caches are not cleared before the single conversion
replacement_to_normalized_conversion.index_policy: reuses lookup indexes created before update timing; index DDL is excluded
replacement_to_normalized_conversion.timing_scope: client wall time from the first replacement scan through primary-key deduplication into eight normalized tables, creation of all eight FK relationship types from converted FK properties, and deletion of the replacement input; every result is consumed and every batch committed
replacement_to_normalized_conversion.excluded_from_timer: removal of the prebuilt normalized comparison layout and routing anchors, index DDL, post-conversion validation, source fingerprinting, and final cleanup

replacement.reason: the timed layout is authoritative and lossless; unlike the legacy counterfactual it materializes unmatched residual rows and their topology, and its role-occurrence representation may therefore have a different physical footprint
